sketch:
Observe: three scope panels showing an analogue sinusoid, a
quantized (staircase) numeric version, and a two-level logic signal
derived from the same source. Sliders control sample rate f_s and
quantization bit depth N; student sees aliasing when f_s < 2·f_signal
and steps coarsen as N drops. Experiment: classify a set of
waveforms by dragging them onto (analogique / logique / numérique)
bins. Evaluate: given a numeric signal, pick the (f_s, N) that
generated it. Wrinkle: Shannon-Nyquist threshold snap when the
aliased frequency crosses.
